title: 巴拿马前副外长：运河中立能扛住中美博弈冲击吗
speaker: Carlos Riz Hernandez

segments.en: I think it was designed for this kind of shocks. If you look at Panama kind of being able to position itself as a safe haven for transit for these ships and vessels, how does Panama position itself geopolitically to make sure it maintains the optics of being a safe, neutral place to go?
segments.zh: 它正是为这类冲击设计的。巴拿马如何在地缘政治上定位自己，以保持安全中立的形象？

segments.en: I mean, there was a moment not so long ago where the President of the United States was threatening to invade and repossess the canal accusing Panama of giving an advantage to China. How does Panama balance its relationship between the U.S. and China and now with everything going on the Gulf?
segments.zh: 不久前美国总统还威胁入侵并收回运河，指责巴拿马给中国优势。巴拿马如何平衡中美关系？

segments.en: What is Panama's relationship with that region as well? And is there anything you're looking towards making stronger ties within the future?
segments.zh: 巴拿马与海湾地区的关系如何？未来是否加强联系？

segments.en: Absolutely. I think, yeah, this, this last couple of years have been a little bit more of a PR that we've expected usually with all this now, but I think Panama's image has been very clear and consistent.
segments.zh: 当然。过去几年公关压力比预期大，但巴拿马的形象一直清晰一致。

segments.en: Panama Canal is Panamanian. It operates neutrally. It's open to all flags equally.
segments.zh: 巴拿马运河属于巴拿马，中立运营，对所有国旗平等开放。

segments.en: And that's exactly for moments like this is how neutrality, why neutrality works, it absorbs energy shocks and guarantees that its largest user, which are U.S. companies, can go straight to do and continue to do their business.
segments.zh: 这正是中立发挥作用的方式：吸收冲击，确保最大用户——美国公司——能继续开展业务。

segments.en: I mean, I think the whole situation has relied on continuity and not risk. I mean, geopolitical headwinds, they'll come and go.
segments.zh: 整个局势依赖连续性而非风险。地缘政治逆风来来去去。

segments.en: A lot of what's happened in the last few years, very unfortunate, but the Panama Canal is ready for this kind of things. And I think that's exactly what we've done in the last couple of years, the government.
segments.zh: 过去几年很多事很不幸，但巴拿马运河已做好准备。这正是政府过去几年所做的。

segments.en: And do you have to remember that the Panama Canal Authority is completely separate from the government. Both institutions work well and when geopolitics and great power competition have come to our shores, we've relied on those institutions to precisely do what they're designed to do.
segments.zh: 要记住运河管理局完全独立于政府。当大国竞争来临时，我们依赖这些机构履行职责。

segments.en: And Panama on the canal side, we have the Panama Canal Authority has been around for about 40 years and we've been total Panamanian for the last 25 years since the year 2000.
segments.zh: 运河管理局已成立约40年，自2000年起完全由巴拿马管理25年。

segments.en: And we haven't had any big problems and major situations except the droughts, which are the real constraints, more than geopolitical headwinds.
segments.zh: 除了干旱这一真正制约因素外，没有出现重大问题，干旱比地缘政治逆风更严峻。

segments.en: I mean, the relationship with the region is excellent. Our foreign minister and our authorities have been coming and going. We hope our relations with Saudi Arabia this year, we're open embassies, we're literally preparing for this interconnected complexity, but great power competition has brought to us.
segments.zh: 与地区关系极好。外长和官员往来频繁。今年希望与沙特阿拉伯建交，开设使馆，为互联复杂性做准备。
